info.title: UnNEET API
info.description: Search jobs, apprenticeships, courses, training and support across the UK, get explainable matches, take interest quizzes and see a personalised timeline of what to do when. Public endpoints need no key. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.

get.summary: What to do, and when, for where you are now
get.description: A personalised, date-aware plan: what to do now, soon, later, what you may have missed, and the three most useful next steps. Exact dates (UCAS deadlines and so on) come from a sourced, verified calendar; everything else is a typical window and says so. Stateless: nothing is stored.

post.description: Send what you know about yourself and get opportunities ranked for you, each with plain-English reasons, whether you are eligible, and whether it is a stretch. Stateless: your profile is used for this request and not stored. A few picks outside your usual sectors are included on purpose (`explore`), so results do not lock you into a stereotype.

profile.description: What you have told us. Everything is optional: the more you add, the better the matches.

includeIneligible.description: Keep things you may not be eligible for (flagged) instead of hiding them.

post.summary: Turn a CV into a draft profile
post.description: Upload a PDF or Word file (multipart, field `file`) or paste the text (JSON, field `text`). We suggest skills, your highest qualification, job titles and years of experience for you to review. The CV is processed in memory and never stored; we deliberately do not extract names, e-mail addresses, phone numbers or addresses.

file.description: Multipart requests: a PDF or Word (.docx) file, up to 5 MB and 15 pages.

text.description: JSON requests: the text of your CV, pasted in (20–100,000 characters).
